notes.threshold_auto: Global threshold is mean + std over active W1/W2 activation_kurtosis scores.
notes.kmeans_2cluster: Manual 1D 2-means fallback; high cluster promoted per expert/projection.
notes.weak_column_gap: Largest descending-score gap per expert/projection, capped at 50% promotion.
notes.submodular_greedy: Equivalent to sort-and-split under uniform item size within each projection.

sort_and_split.description: Two-level routing-aware top-k split using activation_kurtosis at 25%/25%.

sort_and_split_hessian.description: Two-level routing-aware top-k split using hessian_diag at 25%/25%.

threshold_auto.description: Global mean+std threshold over activation_kurtosis across all active W1/W2 channels.

kmeans_2cluster.description: Per-expert 2-cluster split on activation_kurtosis; high cluster promoted to FP8.

weak_column_gap.description: Per-expert largest-gap split on activation_kurtosis with a 50% cap.

per_projection_split.description: Two-level routing-aware split with W1=10% FP8 and W2=40% FP8 using activation_kurtosis.

submodular_greedy.description: Routing-aware greedy promotion by activation_kurtosis until the 25% budget is filled.

combined_metric.description: Two-level routing-aware top-k split using hessian_diag * activation_kurtosis.
